findings.desc: gate subjectId null-bypass: verifyUsageReceipt checks `subjectId !== undefined` but not `typeof subjectId === \u0027string\u0027`; a runtime-null subjectId (injected via JS cast) satisfies the condition when envelope.storyId is also null (non-story call), producing receiptVerified=true without a genuine string subject binding. Fix: replace the guard with `typeof subjectId === \u0027string\u0027 && subjectId === envelope.storyId`. No test covers this adversarial case.

FORBIDDEN_NORMALIZED_NAMES in buildUsageEvidenceEnvelope missing tool-call and env-var entries: toolarguments, toolargs, rawtoolarguments, rawtoolargs, rawtoolresult, toolresult, env, environmentvariables, envvars are in record.ts denylist but absent from authority-evidence.ts supplementary set. Separator-variant forms like TOOL_ARGUMENTS or ENV_VARS evade BOTH scanForbiddenFields (exact-lowercase miss) and scanSeparatorVariants (missing entries), allowing the builder to compute a digest of a source record containing raw tool-call data or env vars without throwing ForbiddenEvidenceMaterialError.
